summary: Groovebox of Bastl-style modules patched with touch cables across three screens: Wave Bard, Kompas, Crust 2, Pizza, Alchemist, Basil and ABC. Patch with jack-group windows and CONNECT; 36 factory patches plus your own (up to 512) with tag filtering. MPC OS 3.x.
